CRM · Loyalty · Customer Experience · Digital Migration

United Petroleum

Marketing Intern

United Petroleum was transitioning 200K+ fuel-discount customers from its existing card system to a new mobile app.

My work covered different parts of that transition, from reviewing the customer journey and planning migration communications to maintaining customer-facing station data and supporting the UP Community loyalty programme.

01

Customer Migration

United was moving existing fuel-discount customers off its card system and onto a new app, built with digital partner ID Digital. The discount stayed the same. How customers accessed it didn't.

  • Reviewed the evolving app experience from the customer's side
  • Fed back on interface and customer journey changes
  • Contributed to journey development for new and existing users
  • Helped build the phased migration timeline
  • Weighed comms timing against technical delivery constraints
02

Communicating Through Change

The migration reached customers in four phases, each one messaging only the people who hadn't already moved across from the phase before.

500,000+ customer emails distributed across the migration
4 comms phases 6 email drafts 20+ FAQs updated
Email ↓ Customer question ↓ FAQ / website
  • Helped write and edit the email copy for each phase
  • Worked on structure and tone across a large, mixed customer base
  • Updated and reorganised the FAQ content on the website
  • Made transition information easier for customers to find themselves
03

The Data Behind The Experience

Every fuel discount depends on the right station showing up in the right place, with the right hours. I cross-checked station information against Google and internal systems, and flagged discrepancies in details like location, operating hours and facilities, verifying with station managers and partners where needed.

500+ service stations checked
100+ discrepancies corrected

Also validated: 40+ club partner details as new clubs joined the program.

What the customer sees
United: Example Location
Hours6:00am – 10:00pm
FacilitiesCar wash, EFTPOS
Fuel discountAccepted

Illustrative: a simple stand-in for the listing a customer checks, not an actual station record.

The data behind it
04

Not Every Customer Needs The Same Message

UP Community had 800+ registered clubs and associations, with very different levels of activity. Some were close to earning a fundraising rebate. Many others had gone quiet.

I reviewed club activity and rebate data to work out who was worth a direct call and who was better served by a scaled email.

Club activity data
Closer to threshold Personalised phone outreach
Further from threshold Email re-engagement
120+ clubs reviewed for re-engagement 30+ contacted individually 800+ clubs in the wider community
05

Building The Community

Alongside re-engagement, I supported the day-to-day running of UP Community, reviewing new applications and helping clubs promote their participation.

  • Reviewed new club applications and verified their details
  • Communicated directly with clubs throughout the process
  • Approved eligible organisations into the programme
  • Generated customised QR-code promotional material for clubs
  • Suggested ways clubs could promote their own participation
50+ new clubs onboarded
Scale Of The Work

What this covered, across one internship

200K+ customers within the app migration
500K+ migration emails distributed
500+ service station records checked
100+ data discrepancies corrected
800+ clubs in the loyalty community
50+ clubs onboarded
